full_prompt_en: A square naturalistic digital landscape image looks across a rocky conifer forest clearing toward pale, hazy hills. The upper background is a washed cream-blue sky, with distant ridges and a dense line of tiny treetops gradually losing contrast in the mist. Midground conifers rise at varied heights, their dark green silhouettes separating patches of sunlit meadow and shadowed undergrowth. Large evergreen branches enter from the upper left and right, loosely framing the open center. The foreground is uneven ground covered with dry grass, low shrubs, scattered stones, and a faint narrow trail that passes through the middle. Pale rock faces on the left catch the strongest sunlight, while darker boulders and tree roots break up the right side. Short grass and bush textures alternate with exposed earth so the clearing feels navigable rather than like a flat green carpet. The path narrows into the forest and disappears behind overlapping trees before the hazy ridgeline. There is no visible person, vehicle, or building within this selected landscape; the scale is carried by the trees and the long recession of terrain. Light arrives from the bright upper right sky, grazing rock surfaces and the tops of shrubs while leaving dense branches and the right foreground in cool shade. Fine leaf detail and rocky texture remain sharp nearby, then soften quickly into atmospheric distance. The muted olive, moss, brown, and blue-gray palette stays close to natural earth colors. The overall composition uses darker tree frames and a winding bright center to lead into a spacious, quiet wilderness with game-cinematic depth.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形自然主义数字风景图像越过一片岩石与针叶林交错的空地，望向浅淡朦胧的山丘。上方背景是被冲淡的奶油蓝天空，远处山脊和密集细小树顶在雾里逐渐失去反差。中景针叶树高低不一，深绿色剪影将受光草地与背阴灌木分开。大块常绿树枝从左上和右上伸入，松松框住开阔中心。前景地面不平，覆有干草、矮灌木、散石和一条穿过中央的淡淡窄径。左侧浅色岩面接住最强的日光，右侧较深的巨石与树根则打断地面。短草与灌丛纹理同裸土交替，使空地可供通行，而不是平铺绿毯。小径向林中收窄，在重叠树木后消失，前方才是朦胧山脊。这幅选定的地景里没有可见人物、车辆或建筑；尺度由树木和地势的长长后退关系承担。光从明亮的右上方天空到来，擦亮岩面和灌木顶部，让密枝及右前景保持冷影。近处叶片与岩石纹理清楚，向空气感远景迅速柔化。低饱和橄榄绿、苔绿、棕色和蓝灰色都接近自然土色。整体构图以较深树木边框和蜿蜒亮中心引向广阔安静的野地，具有游戏电影般纵深。
style_prompt_en: The image has naturalistic digital-environment rendering with detailed near textures and rapid atmospheric softening toward distance. Muted olive, moss, dry brown, and blue-gray form layered terrain rather than flat color bands. Dark irregular edge masses frame a lighter route through the center, giving the composition both guidance and openness. Sunlight glances over raised rough surfaces from a high side angle; deep organic shadows preserve contrast under dense forms. Fine texture is selective, strongest in the foreground, while far silhouettes merge with pale haze. The overall treatment is immersive, grounded, and quietly cinematic.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有自然主义数字环境渲染效果，近处纹理细致，远处随空气距离迅速柔化。低饱和橄榄绿、苔绿、干棕和蓝灰色构成层叠地势，而非平直色带。深色不规则边缘团块框住中央较亮通路，让构图既有引导又开阔。阳光从偏高侧面掠过凸起粗糙表面，密集形体下的有机深影保留对比。细节有选择地集中于前景，远处剪影并入浅雾。整体处理沉浸、扎实而安静地具电影感。
theme_en: A rocky conifer forest clearing recedes into misty hills
theme_zh: 岩石与针叶林之间的空地延向朦胧山丘
name: First-person view
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
